facts.fact: WHO Congo's annual report for 2025 says its support strengthened the health information system during 2025: 401 data collectors were equipped for electronic transmission of data and the national list of health indicators was drawn up; it gives no denominator for the collectors, does not say at which tier they work and does not name the software.

WHO Congo reports that the 2025 equipping of 401 data collectors for electronic transmission was done with WHO support, and its partner map lists UNFPA, AFD and the EU as the partners working on information systems; it states no domestic budget line for the health information system.
